A 9-case plan-independent v3 extension was frozen before any call (base 17 unchanged; labels derived from the sealed criteria and the A0 cases each mirrors). On it the sealed self_contained fails (a3-06 at 0.60/0.49). Of 8 self_contained candidates, s1_r1c1 passed all 26 cases and the five-role confirmation, but its own round-1 v2 run had a0-17 at 0.52, so it is not accepted across all evidence. The decisive blocker is outside the reopened role: the sealed observable question fails extension cases a3-06 (yes at 0.14/0.30 for an undefined mode label) and a3-07 (unclear at 0.20). The frozen labels cannot be changed and observable was not authorized for reopening, so no five-role rubric can be sealed against v3. The existing seal 37f90cf6 remains the v2 seal.
